heading.title: Suits by or against firms and persons carrying on business in names other than their own

article.title: Appearance of partners.
article.content: Where persons are sued as partners in the name of their firm, they shall appear individually in their own names, but all subsequent proceedings shall, nevertheless, continue in the name of the firm.
article.html:
